method: Reviewed current official DeepSeek Tool Calls, Anthropic strict tool use, Anthropic Structured Outputs and Pydantic 2.9 error and strict-mode documentation. Ran the pinned offline verifier (14 assertions), which compiled both Python fences, executed the Pydantic 2.9.2 example and decision helper, checked strict rejection of a string for an integer, confirmed the default lax coercion example, compared exact demo output and checked historical evidence and direct cross-lesson boundaries. No provider or external network calls were made by the verifier. Also checked the built production page in both themes at 1300px viewport; full-page screenshots show matching 1300px viewport and scroll width. Also sampled the next two lessons at 1280px; document scroll width stayed equal to the viewport, with a 792px article column.
limitations: The 2026-10-08 schema prompts, complete schemas, per-call requests/responses, exact model snapshot and scorer are absent from the current workspace; none of those endpoint results was reproduced.
Provider documentation was checked on 2026-10-21 and describes documented routes and schema subsets; it does not prove a compatibility proxy or deployed endpoint behaves identically.

The local Pydantic demo verifies parsing, strict integer typing, declared multiple-of/enum constraints, ISO date parsing, the explicit date-order rule, and a small decision helper; it does not test provider structured-output quality or production authorization.

Anthropic refusal/truncation/casing/complexity caveats were checked against current official docs on 2026-10-21; provider behavior can change and these details must not be generalized to other vendors.
